title: Code, data and proofs for "Roger? Probabilistic Certificates for Safety-Critical ATC Speech Recognition"
description:
Reproducibility package for the TMLR paper Roger? Probabilistic Certificates for Safety-Critical ATC Speech Recognition (Ben Wooding and Taylor T. Johnson).

It contains the analysis, campaign and figure scripts that produced the paper, the raw per-draw experimental data (the complete N = 1000 outcome vector for every model, dataset, message and SNR cell), the stored transcripts used by the semantic-equivalence audit, and the Lean 4 formalization of the paper's results.

One command, python reproduce.py, regenerates every number macro file and figure the camera-ready paper reads and checks each one against the published version. With no audio and no GPU, all 39 files reproduce exactly: text byte for byte, figures pixel for pixel. --from-raw also rebuilds the revision per-draw tables from the raw decode dumps (16/16 identical).

Not included: model weights and third-party audio. The archived LiveATC recordings are not redistributable; a manifest gives each certified clip's SHA-256, public source and cut offsets so the identical audio can be rebuilt.
